scripts.text:
[Izlude: The Satellite City]
Welcome to Izlude, the satellite of Prontera. Izlude was built to support Prontera's defense and to accommodate its burgeoning population.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得島：衛星之城]
歡迎來到依斯魯得島，普隆德拉的衛星城。
依斯魯得島是為了支援普隆德拉的防禦，以及容納其日益增長的人口而建立的。

scripts.text:
[Izlude: The Satellite City]
Points of interest include the Swordsman Association building which allows adventurers to change their job to Swordsman, and the Battle Area that is North of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得島：衛星之城]
這裡的名勝包括劍士協會大樓，冒險者可以在那裡轉職為劍士，以及位於依斯魯得島北方的戰鬥區域。

scripts.text:
[Izlude: The Satellite City]
At the docks, you may take a ship and travel to ^123972Alberta^000000 or ^2F0400Byalan Island^000000.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得島：衛星之城]
在碼頭，您可以乘坐船隻前往^123972艾爾貝塔^000000或^2F0400拜蘭島^000000。

scripts.text:
[Izlude: The Satellite City]
From Izlude, ^6D6FE0Prontera^000000 is located to the Northwest, and ^1F3A11Payon^000000 is located to the South.
Enjoy your travels in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得島：衛星之城]
從依斯魯得島出發，^6D6FE0普隆德拉^000000位於西北方，^1F3A11斐揚^000000位於南方。
祝您在盧恩·米德加茲王國旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Dungeon]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Geffen dungeon is consisted of 3 levels
is too difficult for new adventurers to venture.
As main monsters constantly appear,
there are ^6B1312Hunter Flies^000000, ^6B1312Nightmares^000000 and ^6B1312Jakks^000000.
Nightmares and Jakks only appear in this dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬地下城]
^6B1312注意！^000000
吉芬地下城共有3層，對於新手冒險者來說難度過高。
這裡會不斷重新整理主要魔物，包括^6B1312獵人蠅^000000、^6B1312夢魘^000000和^6B1312南瓜先生^000000。
夢魘和南瓜先生僅在此地下城出現。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Dungeon]
On the 2nd level of this dungeon,
^6B1312Ogretooth^000000, the creature of a doomed sword and ^6B1312Dracula^000000,
the boss monster appear without warning.
On the 3rd level, ^6B1312Doppelganger^000000 one of the strongest boss monster appears at certain time.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬地下城]
在地下城的第2層，揹負著宿命之劍的魔物^6B1312獸牙怪^000000，以及Boss魔物^6B1312德古拉^000000，會毫無預兆地出現。
在第3層，^6B1312分身^000000，作為最強的Boss魔物之一，會在特定時間出現。

scripts.text:
[The Magma Dungeon, Nogg Road]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Nogg Road is filled with very dangerous creatures.
It is limited to enter only to well-experienced adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[熔岩地下城 諾格之路]
^6B1312注意！^000000
諾格之路充滿了極其危險的魔物。
僅限經驗豐富的冒險者進入。

scripts.text:
[The Magma Dungeon, Nogg Road]
Main Monsters of this dungeon is
^6B1312Kahos^000000 and ^6B1312Nightmare Terrors^000000.
Please be attentive.
scripts.translation:
[熔岩地下城 諾格之路]
此地下城的主要魔物是^6B1312卡浩^000000和^6B1312七彩夢魘^000000。
請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Coal Mine]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
The Coal Mine consists of a total of 3 levels. This dungeon is suited to both new and experienced adventurers, depending on the dungeon level.
scripts.translation:
[煤礦]
^6B1312注意！^000000
煤礦共有3層。
根據樓層不同，適合新手和經驗豐富的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Coal Mine]
In the third level, monsters tend to attack adventurers in swarms, so avoid being surrounded. Since this area is a mine, many Ores can be found within the depths of this dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[煤礦]
在第3層，魔物傾向於成群攻擊冒險者，請避免被包圍。
由於這裡是礦區，在地下城深處可以發現許多礦石。

scripts.text:
[Sphinx]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
The Sphinx consists of 5 levels.
This dungeon is suited for training
well-experienced adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[斯芬克斯]
^6B1312注意！^000000
斯芬克斯共有5層。
此地下城適合經驗豐富的冒險者進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Sphinx]
There are many aggressive monsters
residing in the Sphinx, and it is
advised to run away if you happen
to be surrounded by them.
scripts.translation:
[斯芬克斯]
斯芬克斯中棲息著許多好戰的魔物，如果不幸被它們包圍，建議儘快逃離。

scripts.text:
[Sphinx]
In the fifth level, the boss
monster ^6B1312Pharaoh^000000 will appear at
certain times. Exorcise with
extreme prejudice.
scripts.translation:
[斯芬克斯]
在第5層，Boss魔物^6B1312法老王^000000會在特定時間出現。
請全力以赴將其消滅。

scripts.text:
[Clock Tower]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Only well-experienced adventurers
should consider entering the Clock
Tower. There are a total of 8
levels: 4 beneath the ground and 4 above the earth.
scripts.translation:
[鐘樓]
^6B1312注意！^000000
只有經驗豐富的冒險者才應考慮進入鐘樓。
這裡共有8層：
地下4層，地上4層。

scripts.text:
[Clock Tower]
The main monsters of the Clock
Tower are Clocks, Alarms and
Bathories. Beware of the Clock
Tower Keepers on patrol.
scripts.translation:
[鐘樓]
鐘樓的主要魔物是古鐘魔、鍾怪和巴托利。
請小心巡邏的守塔人。

scripts.text:
[Clock Tower]
The paths in the Clock Tower are
winding and complicated, so please
be careful and avoid getting
lost.
scripts.translation:
[鐘樓]
鐘樓內的路徑蜿蜒複雜，請小心行走，避免迷路。

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
The Orc Dungeon is comprised of 2 levels. Although not very strong individually, the monsters here attack in groups. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[獸人地下城]
^6B1312注意！^000000
獸人地下城共有2層。
雖然單個魔物不強，但這裡的魔物會成群攻擊。請小心。

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
Only in this dungeon will you be able to encounter Orc Skeletons, Zenorcs and Orc Zombies.
scripts.translation:
[獸人地下城]
只有在這裡，您才能遇到邪骸獸人、茲諾克和獸人腐屍。

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
Holy attribute weapons will greatly aid you in this place, since most of the monsters in this dungeon are Undead.
scripts.translation:
[獸人地下城]
神聖屬性武器在這裡會大有幫助，因為此地下城的大部分魔物都是不死系。

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
If you don't have a Holy Weapon and you're teamed with a Priest, the Priest's Aspersio spell would be of tremendous help.
scripts.translation:
[獸人地下城]
如果您沒有神聖武器，且隊伍中有牧師，牧師的<灑水祈福>技能將提供巨大的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Toy Factory]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Toy Factory is consisting of 2 levels.
This dungeon is not that difficult to venture for new adventurers,
but there are 3 dangerous boss monsters spawn at certain time.
scripts.translation:
[玩具工廠]
^6B1312注意！^000000
玩具工廠共有2層。
對於新冒險者來說，這裡並不算太難，但在特定時間會重新整理3只危險的BOSS魔物。

scripts.text:
[Toy Factory]
In 1st level, you will encounter a boss monster, ^6B1312Angeling^000000.
In 2nd level, you will encounter 2 dangrous boss monsters which are
^6B1312Stormy Knight^000000 and ^6B1312Hatii^000000. It is advised to be attentive while venturing.
For your reference, ^6B1312Myst Cases^000000, ^6B1312Cruisers^000000 and ^6B1312Cookies^000000 only appear in this dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[玩具工廠]
在第1層，您會遇到BOSS魔物^6B1312天使波利^000000。
在第2層，您會遇到2只危險的BOSS魔物，分別是^6B1312冰暴騎士^000000和^6B1312卡侖^000000。建議您在探索時保持警惕。
供參考，^6B1312邪惡禮盒^000000、^6B1312玩具士兵^000000和^6B1312綠餅人^000000僅在此地下城出現。

scripts.text:
[Payon Cave]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Payon Cave consists of 5 levels full of Undead and Demon monsters. Beware of swarms of Hydra in the third and fourth levels.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚洞穴]
^6B1312注意！^000000
斐揚洞穴共有5層，充滿了不死系和惡魔系魔物。請小心第3層和第4層成群出現的海葵。

scripts.text:
[Payon Cave]
In the fifth level, there is a pretty, yet dreadful boss monster known as ^6B1312Moonlight^000000 that spawns at certain times. Approach with extreme caution.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚洞穴]
在第5層，有一隻美麗卻可怕的BOSS魔物^6B1312月光^000000，會在特定時間重新整理。請務必謹慎接近。

scripts.text:
[Pyramids]
^6B1312Caution!^000000
Pyramids is consisting of total 7 levels as 4 levels on the earth and the rest under the ground.
First few levels are suited for new adventurers to venture, but as deeper you go down, you will encounter stronger monsters.
scripts.translation:
[金字塔]
^6B1312注意！^000000
金字塔共有7層，其中4層位於地面，其餘位於地下。
前幾層適合新冒險者探索，但越往深處走，遇到的魔物越強。

scripts.text:
[Pyramids]
In first level, there is the thief guild where people can change their jobs into Thief.
In the 4:th level, a boss monster called ^6B1312Osiris^000000 appears at certain time.
In the 3:d basement, ^6B1312Amon Ra^000000 appears at certain time.
scripts.translation:
[金字塔]
在第1層，有盜賊公會，人們可以在那裡轉職為盜賊。
在第4層，BOSS魔物^6B1312俄塞里斯^000000會在特定時間出現。
在地下3層，^6B1312古埃及王^000000會在特定時間出現。

scripts.text:
[Culvert]
Culvert is comprised of a total of
4 levels, and is a good training
ground for new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[下水道]
下水道共有4層，是新冒險者很好的訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Culvert]
In order to access the Culver, you
must volunteer as a monster
exterminator at the Prontera
Chivalry. Remember that the
monsters here may attack in
swarms.
scripts.translation:
[下水道]
要進入下水道，您必須在普隆德拉騎士團登記為魔物討伐志願者。請記住，這裡的魔物可能會成群攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Culvert]
In the fourth level of the Prontera
Culvert, you may encounter the boss
monster known as the ^6B1312Golden Thief
^6B1312Bug^000000. New adventurers should
exercise caution.
scripts.translation:
[下水道]
在普隆德拉下水道第4層，您可能會遇到名為^6B1312黃金盜賊蟲^6B1312^000000的Boss魔物。
新手冒險者請務必小心。
